_readme: Manual context the FPL API can't express.
PREFER PLAYER IDS. A name key that matches more than one player is
REFUSED, not guessed at — 'Sangare' matches both M.Sangare and
I.Sangare, who play for different clubs. Find an id with:
exclude       true  -> drop from the pool entirely
avail         0..1  -> scales the chance of featuring at all
p_start       0..1  -> replaces the start probability outright
minutes_mult  0..1+ -> scales minutes PER START (a managed return plays
xg90 / xa90 / defcon90 / bps90 -> override a per-90 rate directly
note          free text, echoed when applied
The three minutes knobs act on different things and compose without
compounding. Every applied override is printed with resulting E[min], so

The minutes prior takes LAST SEASON'S ROLE at face value. When a player's role has changed — injuries ahead of him, a transfer, a new manager — that is invisible to the model and this file is the only fix.
Delete entries once stale. An override that outlives its situation is

565.note: M.Sangare (BRE). No prior season, so price heuristic has him at 6.5 defcon/90 and p_start 0.43. GW1: started, 75 min, 13 CBIRT. REMOVE once ~5 games of real data exist.

11.note: Mosquera (ARS). Last season 9 starts / 986 min as a backup, so the minutes prior has him at p_start 0.41 — but Saliba is out for months and Timber is not back in first-team training, and he started GW1 for 90. Role changed; the API cannot see it. REVIEW when Saliba or Timber returns, or if Konsa signs.
